```{r load libraries}
library(Seurat) 
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
library(DESeq2)
```


```{r Load the integrated file}

data <- readRDS("/path_to_folder/HarmonyIntegrated_annotated_data_final.rds")

# filter
#change filter conditions based on the file
seu.filtered <- subset(data, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 &
                         nCount_RNA > 800 & 
                         percent.mt < 5 
)

# run Seurat's standard workflow steps
seu.filtered <- NormalizeData(seu.filtered)
seu.filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seu.filtered)
seu.filtered <- ScaleData(seu.filtered)
seu.filtered <- RunPCA(seu.filtered)
seu.filtered <- RunUMAP(seu.filtered, dims = 1:20)

```

```{r preparing the counts matrix for pseudobulk comparison}
seu.filtered$CellTypes <- Idents(seu.filtered)

# pseudo-bulk workflow -----------------
# Acquiring necessary metrics for aggregation across cells in a sample
# 1. counts matrix - sample level
# counts aggregate to sample level
#see if we need to do this 

seu.filtered$samples <- paste0(seu.filtered$orig.ident, seu.filtered$CellTypes)

cts <- AggregateExpression(seu.filtered, 
                           group.by = c("CellTypes", "sample"),
                           assays = 'RNA',
                           slot = "counts",
                           return.seurat = FALSE)

cts <- cts$RNA

# transpose
cts.t <- t(cts)

# convert to data.frame
cts.t <- as.data.frame(cts.t)

# get values where to split
splitRows <- gsub('_.*', '', rownames(cts.t))

# split data.frame
cts.split <- split.data.frame(cts.t,
                              f = factor(splitRows))

# fix colnames and transpose
cts.split.modified <- lapply(cts.split, function(x){
  rownames(x) <- gsub('.*_(.*)_', '\\1', rownames(x))
  t(x)
  
})


```

```{r DESeq2}
# Let's run DE analysis with Multiciliated
# 1. Get counts matrix
counts_mnn <- cts.split.modified$`Select cell type`

#2 generate sample level metadata - do it for each "control" sample vs "treated" sample   

condition <- factor(c("Grp1", "Grp2", "Grp3"))

mnn_coldata <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(counts_mnn), condition)

# Set factor level
mnn_coldata$condition <- relevel(mnn_coldata$condition, ref = "nonsmoker") 

# perform DESeq2 --------
# Create DESeq2 object   
mnn_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_mnn,
                                  colData = mnn_coldata,
                                  design = ~ condition)

# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(mnn_dds)) >=10
mnn_dds <- mnn_dds[keep,]

# run DESeq2
mnn_dds <- DESeq(mnn_dds)

# Generate results object
res01 <- results(mnn_dds, name = "condition_grp3_vs_grp1")
summary(res01)

write.csv(as.data.frame(res01), file="/path_to_folder/grp3_vs_grp1_mnn.csv")
saveRDS(res01, "/path_to_folder/grp3_vs_grp1_mnn.rds")

Sig_res01 <- subset(res01, padj < 0.05)
summary(Sig_res01)
head(Sig_res01)
write.csv(as.data.frame(Sig_res01), file="/path_to_folder/grp3_vs_grp1_mnn_sig.csv")


```{r Z score}
# Z-scores of important parameters


mat_1 <- counts(mnn_dds, normalized = T)[rownames(Sig_res01),]

#Z score
mat1.z <- t(apply(mat_1, 1, scale))
colnames(mat1.z) <- rownames(mnn_coldata)
head(mat1.z)

write.csv(as.data.frame(mat1.z), file="/path_to_folder/Figure 8/sig_Zscore_grp3_vs_grp1_mnn.csv")

```
